correctness.rationale: The exact wall replay uses Cramer determinants with only the last row varying in d; the common unimodular denominators are the same at 0 and 1, so stay constant, and the numerator degrees are affine. The nonconstant degrees d, 1−d, d+5, −d−2 and all constants have no zero for d≥2. The convex identity is positive with coefficients summing to one. On D7 the successive projected rays give the single subdivision of the product fan, and the degrees on E, Fx, Fy give K restricted as (d−1)Fx−2Fy+3E. The two opposite signs on the nef ruling classes exclude pseudo-effectivity for either sign. The (d−1,2) system is very ample; a general smooth irreducible member avoids p, so the exceptional term contributes zero. The two ruling terms cancel and adjunction gives d−2. Nonzero ambient wall degrees rule out invariance.
residual_risks: Degree zero is numerical, not a claim that the canonical bundle restricts trivially. Computation checks wall arithmetic, not Bertini or fan completeness; the proof and published construction supply these.

value.rationale: The surviving result diagnoses the obstruction geometrically rather than retesting the known ambient criterion. The two nef rulings of opposite canonical sign explain why the obstruction accommodates moving degree-zero curves that miss the exceptional locus, contrasting with the effective restriction and curve through p in the previously exhibited slice. The genus formula makes this distinction explicit over the complete displayed range.
